basic_info.description: New Modern Masterpiece in Bernal Heights  Experience contemporary living at its finest in this stunning, never-lived-in home perched in sought-after Bernal Heights. With vaulted ceilings, abundant natural light, and private outdoor space on every level, this architectural gem offers a seamless blend of style and functionality. Originally permitted in 2012, construction was completed in 2025, making this a rare opportunity to own a brand-new residence in a prime San Francisco neighborhood. The main level welcomes you with soaring ceilings, an open-concept gourmet kitchen with a large island, a spacious dining area, and a light-filled living room that opens onto a private patioperfect for entertaining. A stylish half bath completes this level. The ground floor serves as a private retreat, featuring a luxurious primary suite with backyard access, a dedicated laundry area, and possible two-car garage with storage. The top floor offers versatility, boasting two bedrooms, one of which is open to the level belowideal for an office, gym/ den. A full bathroom and an expansive deck with breathtaking views complete this elevated living experience.  Ideally located near Cortland Avenue's shops and dining, Bernal Hill and convenient commuter routes, this home is modern and convenient.
